name: feedback-turnoff-question
for: The question the runtime can ask after the card is dismissed with Escape: 'Turn off Claude-drafted feedback? 0 to turn off · Esc to keep', a plain row (not boxed) above a composer that reads whole. It hides nothing, so the session is idle and takes messages; this case pins that it is neither unknown nor a prompt. It is recognised for one reason: a message that is only 0 would answer it, and turn the feature off. See TestSendOfALoneDigitUnderTheTurnOffQuestionIsRefused.
redactedFrom: real capture of an 80-column, 24-row pane running the runtime with drafts on, redacted by corpus-redact; the status text is kept because it is, whole, the runtime's own vocabulary, and every row of the draft above it is the agent's and is discarded
